_meta.name: chitchat.gg protocol manifest
_meta.rule: Every fact below is evidence-backed. Anything not captured is listed in 'unknowns' and MUST NOT be guessed in code. Code may only implement what appears here.
_meta.note_v2: Deep-audit pass 2: write endpoints corrected to EMPTY body (0 bytes) per body_size evidence; queue-wait uses GET /match/active; own-typing-echo guarded.

auth.mechanism: cookie-based (no auth payload in Socket.IO CONNECT)
auth.evidence: capture shows CONNECT payload is only {"release":"<git sha>"}; browser attaches cookies automatically on wss upgrade

cookies.name: token
cookies.desc: JWT (eyJhbGciOiJIU...), set on login/signup, scopes the whole .chitchat.gg session

handshake_sequence.note: namespace connect; release = frontend git sha (telemetry, value from capture)
client sends this right after connect

disconnect_frame.note: server may close the socket (observed in redacted capture); client must reconnect with backoff

chatMessage.note: OWN messages are echoed back too (author == self). Bot must filter by author.id != self_id. Evidence: capture user 6a9257898ac97f8d3c432262 'rheumatic rifleman' messages 'hi','f','24','yes','hlw' appear in incoming feed while user typed them locally.

states.evidence: 07_match_updates.json: matchUpdate with closure.closed=false arrives immediately when POST /match returns {"matched":true}

typing.note: server-side echo of OWN typing back to sender was NOT observed in capture (all captured typing events were from the partner). Client defensively ignores typing events with userId == self_id.

updateRelationship.note: friend request / relationship changes; bot can ignore

POST /match.desc: join text-match queue (this is what the site's 'Next'/start does)
POST /match.request_body: EMPTY body (0 bytes) with Content-Type: application/json header — captured 32/32 requests body_size=0
POST /match.behavior: if matched=true, matchUpdate (closed=false) arrives over WS within ~40ms

PATCH /match/disconnect.request_body: EMPTY body (0 bytes) with Content-Type header — captured 18/18 body_size=0
PATCH /match/disconnect.effect: partner receives matchUpdate closure.closed=true closeReason=INTENTIONAL closedBy=<our id>

POST /users/me/conversations/{conversati.effect: partner receives WS event typing {userId, conversationId}

request.evidence: captured ct=multipart/form-data twice; body content not captured by tool
request.note: field names inferred from response keys 'content' and 'nonce'; NOT directly captured. If server rejects, config message_body_format=json sends {"content":..., "nonce":...} instead.

POST /users/me/conversations/{conversati.response_201: Message object (see message_object) incl. server id and nonce echo

PATCH /users/me/conversations/{conversat.note: mark conversation read; optional for bot

GET /users/me/conversations/{conversatio.note: history fetch; bot uses it for reconnect recovery

POST /auth/login.note: not needed for bot; bot uses existing session cookies

message_object.nonce: client-generated UUID v4, echoed by server

match_object.partner_resolution: partner = the participant whose profile.id != self_id

flow_timeline_observed.queue_to_match: POST /match at 05:29:21.616 -> matchUpdate closed=false at 05:29:21.580 (same instant, matched instantly when partner waiting)
flow_timeline_observed.partner_skip_then_next: matchUpdate closed=true 05:29:35.783 -> POST /match 05:29:37.369 (1.6s later) -> matchUpdate closed=false 05:29:37.353
flow_timeline_observed.human_reply_pattern: typing POST 05:29:30.149 -> message POST 05:29:30.669 (~0.5s between typing and send)
flow_timeline_observed.ws_reconnect: site opens new WS on page activity; server also sends 41 occasionally (duplicate-connection management). Client must auto-reconnect.
flow_timeline_observed.queue_wait: capture never showed a queue wait (all matches instant). Client therefore polls captured GET /match/active while waiting and only re-POSTs /match when inQueue=false.

rate_limits.rule: assume ~500 req/min per IP bucket; bot delays must keep well below

unknowns_DO_NOT_GUESS: exact multipart field names of POST /messages (only ct=multipart/form-data + response keys content/nonce are captured; bot has json fallback config)
media/image upload field name (never captured; bot does not send media)
reactions API shape (12_reactions.json empty in capture)
match preference body for POST /match (captured body was empty; matchPreferences filtering via API body was never observed)
video chat signaling (out of scope: text-only bot)
